note: Domains and weights follow Microsoft's published skills-measured outline for AB-410. Two things about this page are worth recording so nobody 'corrects' them later. First, the exam name and the credential name differ: the study guide heading reads 'Building Intelligent Applications' while the credential it earns is 'Intelligent Applications Builder', which is the title carried in catalog.json. Both are correct for what they name. Second, like SC-500, AI-300, AZ-802 and AI-200 this guide carries no 'Skills measured as of <date>' line — Microsoft publishes a single undated skills list. Despite sitting in the AB series, AB-410 is a Power Platform exam: it overlaps PL-400 and PL-300 far more than it overlaps the AB Fundamentals.
